"""Root-only, one-shot staging deployment after exact reviewed publication."""
import hashlib,json,re,subprocess,urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
if not __debug__: raise RuntimeError('Optimized execution refused')
read=lambda p:json.loads(Path(p).read_bytes())
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
admission=read('.superpowers/m78-get-route-deployment-admission.json')
assert admission['status']=='m78_get_route_deployment_admitted'
commit=admission['commit'];assert re.fullmatch('[a-f0-9]{40}',commit)
for pin in admission['pins']:
 assert sha(Path(pin['path']).read_bytes())==pin['sha256'],pin['path']
assert any(p['path']=='.superpowers/m78-get-route-deploy-once.py' for p in admission['pins'])
assert admission['routeSha256']=='fd9b1115130d523629e58b5fcef06fe5355eedc8afd12d6dacc998623c89ff37'
assert sha(Path('apps/site-api/src/workspace/m78-routes.ts').read_bytes())==admission['routeSha256']
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','-c','maintenance.auto=false','-c','gc.auto=0','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()==commit
ci=read('.superpowers/m78-get-route-publication-checks.json')
assert ci['sha']==ci['pr_head']==commit and ci['state']=='open'
assert 0<=(datetime.now(timezone.utc)-datetime.fromisoformat(ci['observed_at'])).total_seconds()<180
required={'GHG calculation specifications and engine','Offline research catalog tests','Typecheck, lint, unit tests and web builds','Dedicated staging image and offline runtime smoke','Role routing and evidence records','Native PostgreSQL worksheet and tenant regression'}
assert {c['name'] for c in ci['checks']}==required and all(c['status']=='completed' and c['conclusion']=='success' for c in ci['checks'])
assert any(p['path']=='.superpowers/m78-get-route-publication-checks.json' for p in admission['pins'])
result=read('evaluations/research-qa/m78-get-local-comparison-result.json')
assert sha(Path('evaluations/research-qa/m78-get-local-comparison-result.json').read_bytes())=='caae59a5d5704c53b6d61f901d30dee55be01b7f890c62e7d6e5c1b1b7931417'
assert result['status']=='m78_get_route_local_comparison_passed' and result['localConnectionsClosed'] is True
qa=read(admission['nativeReview']['path'])
assert sha(Path(admission['nativeReview']['path']).read_bytes())==admission['nativeReview']['sha256']
assert qa['reviewerId']=='/root/m78_transport_probe' and qa['materialFindingsOpen']==0 and qa['status']=='m78_get_local_comparison_independently_passed'
assert qa['actualResult']['sha256']=='caae59a5d5704c53b6d61f901d30dee55be01b7f890c62e7d6e5c1b1b7931417' and qa['routeSha256']==admission['routeSha256']
cli=['C:/Users/nimab/.bun/bin/bunx.exe','@railway/cli']
rows=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(cli+['deployment','list','--project','119f3652-9d84-4d16-983c-1a17c0fd1aaa','--service','f43abcf9-72f0-4034-828a-8d83ca26b0db','--environment','6642d65a-15a2-41e9-b25e-b7b01990aa28','--json'],timeout=90).decode('utf-8-sig'))
live=next(r for r in rows if r['id']=='0f2e99f3-67ef-4f4c-b3c3-a39c62eabc78')
assert live['status']=='SUCCESS' and live['meta']['commitHash']=='59cda7a62d8dcc6b554c92372e3b032577e410c9' and live['meta']['imageDigest']=='sha256:fe46a0e354252026f2bcbf6672e10ec550e52a56f064ab3e75a8af17625749c9'
assert not any(r['id']!=live['id'] and r['status'] not in ('REMOVED','FAILED','CRASHED','SKIPPED') for r in rows)
auto=Path('.superpowers/m78-auto-status.graphql');assert auto.read_text().strip()=='query { serviceInstanceAutoDeployStatus(environmentId:"6642d65a-15a2-41e9-b25e-b7b01990aa28",projectId:"119f3652-9d84-4d16-983c-1a17c0fd1aaa",serviceId:"f43abcf9-72f0-4034-828a-8d83ca26b0db") { enabled } }'
a=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(cli+['api','--file',str(auto),'--compact'],timeout=90))
assert not a.get('errors') and a['data']['serviceInstanceAutoDeployStatus']['enabled'] is False
with urllib.request.urlopen('https://www.neuvetra.ai/ready',timeout=30) as response:
 assert response.status==200
 ready=json.load(response)
assert ready=={'status':'ready','profile':'neuvetra.private-synthetic-staging.v1','schemaVersion':21,'legacyContainmentVerified':True}
assert 0<=(datetime.now(timezone.utc)-datetime.fromisoformat(ci['observed_at'])).total_seconds()<180
query='mutation { serviceInstanceDeployV2(environmentId:"6642d65a-15a2-41e9-b25e-b7b01990aa28",serviceId:"f43abcf9-72f0-4034-828a-8d83ca26b0db",commitSha:"'+commit+'") }'
query_path=Path('.superpowers/m78-get-route-deploy.graphql')
with query_path.open('x',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n') as f:f.write(query+'\n')
intent=Path('.superpowers/m78-get-route-deployment-requested.json')
with intent.open('x',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'requestedAt':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'commit':commit,'priorDeploymentId':live['id'],'priorImageDigest':live['meta']['imageDigest'],'ready':ready,'autodeploy':False,'admissionSha256':sha(Path('.superpowers/m78-get-route-deployment-admission.json').read_bytes()),'querySha256':sha(query_path.read_bytes())},indent=2)+'\n')
# The intent is durable before mutation. Any uncertain response blocks blind retry.
with Path('.superpowers/m78-get-route-deployment-response.json').open('xb') as f:
 r=subprocess.run(cli+['api','--file',str(query_path),'--compact'],capture_output=True,timeout=120)
 f.write(r.stdout);f.flush()
 assert r.returncode==0,'Deployment request uncertain; inspect retained receipt, never retry blindly'
 reply=json.loads(r.stdout);assert not reply.get('errors') and isinstance(reply['data']['serviceInstanceDeployV2'],str)
 print(json.dumps({'deploymentId':reply['data']['serviceInstanceDeployV2'],'commit':commit,'requested':True}))

"""Read-only observer for the one retained GET-repair deployment request."""
import json,subprocess,re,urllib.request,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
if not __debug__:raise RuntimeError('Optimized execution refused')
read=lambda p:json.loads(Path(p).read_bytes())
admission=read('.superpowers/m78-get-route-deployment-admission.json')
intent=read('.superpowers/m78-get-route-deployment-requested.json')
reply=read('.superpowers/m78-get-route-deployment-response.json')
assert not reply.get('errors') and isinstance(reply['data']['serviceInstanceDeployV2'],str)
deployment=reply['data']['serviceInstanceDeployV2'];commit=admission['commit']
assert re.fullmatch('[a-f0-9]{40}',commit) and intent['commit']==commit
assert intent['admissionSha256']==hashlib.sha256(Path('.superpowers/m78-get-route-deployment-admission.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
cli=['C:/Users/nimab/.bun/bin/bunx.exe','@railway/cli']
raw=subprocess.check_output(cli+['deployment','list','--project','119f3652-9d84-4d16-983c-1a17c0fd1aaa','--service','f43abcf9-72f0-4034-828a-8d83ca26b0db','--environment','6642d65a-15a2-41e9-b25e-b7b01990aa28','--json'],timeout=90)
rows=json.loads(raw.decode('utf-8-sig'));row=next(r for r in rows if r['id']==deployment)
progress={'observedAt':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'deploymentId':deployment,'status':row['status'],'commit':row.get('meta',{}).get('commitHash')}
Path('.superpowers/m78-get-route-deployment-progress.json').write_text(json.dumps(progress,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
if row['status']!='SUCCESS':
 print(json.dumps(progress));raise SystemExit(0)
assert row['meta']['commitHash']==commit and re.fullmatch('sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}',row['meta']['imageDigest'])
assert not any(r['id']!=deployment and r['status'] not in ('REMOVED','FAILED','CRASHED','SKIPPED') for r in rows)
auto=Path('.superpowers/m78-auto-status.graphql');assert auto.read_text().strip()=='query { serviceInstanceAutoDeployStatus(environmentId:"6642d65a-15a2-41e9-b25e-b7b01990aa28",projectId:"119f3652-9d84-4d16-983c-1a17c0fd1aaa",serviceId:"f43abcf9-72f0-4034-828a-8d83ca26b0db") { enabled } }'
a=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(cli+['api','--file',str(auto),'--compact'],timeout=90));assert not a.get('errors') and a['data']['serviceInstanceAutoDeployStatus']['enabled'] is False
with urllib.request.urlopen('https://www.neuvetra.ai/ready',timeout=30) as response:
 assert response.status==200
 ready=json.load(response)
assert ready=={'status':'ready','profile':'neuvetra.private-synthetic-staging.v1','schemaVersion':21,'legacyContainmentVerified':True}
result={'status':'m78_get_route_deployed_runtime_verified','observedAt':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'deploymentId':deployment,'commit':commit,'imageDigest':row['meta']['imageDigest'],'deploymentStatus':'SUCCESS','httpStatus':200,'ready':ready,'autodeploy':False,'admissionSha256':intent['admissionSha256'],'requestIntentSha256':hashlib.sha256(Path('.superpowers/m78-get-route-deployment-requested.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'deploymentCollectionSha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'recoveryExecuted':False,'restartExecuted':False,'revisitExecuted':False}
with Path('.superpowers/m78-get-route-deployment-verified.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n') as f:f.write(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result))
